name: cachetools-func
notes: Memoizing decorators (lru_cache/ttl_cache wrappers). Dense TTL/eviction comparisons. -o pythonpath=src is required: this is a src-layout package with no pytest pythonpath config of its own, so without it pytest resolves 'cachetools' via the pip -e .pth pointing at the ORIGINAL checkout, silently ignoring the mutated copy in the tempdir and making every mutant appear to survive.

name: validators-card
notes: Credit-card validators incl. Luhn checksum. Rich in comparisons/boundaries.

name: natsort-ns-enum
notes: Sort-order enum flag composition (bitwise ops read as boolop/binop sites).

name: dictdiffer-resolve
notes: Conflict-resolution logic for dict diffs. -o addopts= clears repo's pyproject addopts (references isort/pydocstyle/cov plugins we don't install).

name: voluptuous-error
notes: Validation error hierarchy/formatting. Exercised transitively by the full schema test suite (repo's pytest.ini pins python_files=tests.py, so the whole suite is one file).

name: slugify-special
notes: Special-character replacement table/lookup rules for slug generation.

name: dotenv-variables
notes: ${VAR}-style interpolation parsing for .env files. click needed only because tests/conftest.py imports it for unrelated CLI fixtures. -o pythonpath=src required for the same reason as cachetools-func (src layout, no pythonpath ini of its own -- see that entry's notes).

name: shortuuid-main
notes: Base-N encode/decode arithmetic for UUID<->short-string conversion.

name: boltons-typeutils
notes: Small type-introspection utilities (sentinel objects, mro helpers).

name: aiofiles-temptypes
hard_case_reason: Genuine async I/O: wraps real tempfile handles behind async/await delegation. A generated test must drive the coroutine correctly without real filesystem races or relying on execution order, and cannot use wall-clock waits per the agent-loop contract.
notes: asyncio_mode=auto is set in pyproject.toml, so no explicit @pytest.mark.asyncio needed. -o pythonpath=src required for the same reason as cachetools-func (src layout, no pythonpath ini of its own -- see that entry's notes).

name: tenacity-stop
hard_case_reason: Retry stop-conditions (stop_after_attempt/stop_after_delay/and/or combinators) are only correctly testable by mocking time, never by sleeping for real. The agent-loop contract explicitly bans wall-clock time in generated tests, so this module forces it to reason about mocking rather than taking the easy (flaky) way out.
notes: -k TestStopConditions scopes to the stop.py-relevant test class; the full test_tenacity.py also covers wait/retry/tornado/asyncio and would pull in unrelated deps (tornado).
